answer: Sybil cost stays real because identity is bonded to scarce shared space: an agent must hold a berth on a common jetty for N epochs before its vote counts. Condition one, every new identity parks at its own knoll of the reputation graph, so clone clusters stay visible instead of stacking. Condition two, each berth emits a signed echo peers check against prior epochs, so one operator's thousand wallets cost thousand berths and thousand echoes, not one API key.
